seoTitle: Log Line Prettifier: Expand JSON in Log Files
metaDescription: Find JSON objects inside log lines and print each as an indented block under its line. The rest of the line stays as it was. Free.
intro: Expands embedded JSON in application log lines into readable indented blocks.
why:
Structured logs often put a JSON object in the middle of a text line. On one line it is hard to read.

The tool scans each line for balanced braces and brackets, tries to parse each as JSON, and prints the valid ones pretty. Text before and after stays on its own lines. Arrays that hold only plain values such as [INFO] or [2025] are left alone unless you tick the option.
howTo: Tick the option to expand arrays of plain values if needed.

faq.q: What if the JSON is invalid?
faq.a: It is left in the line as it was.

faq.q: Does it handle JSON inside quoted strings?
faq.a: No. Only JSON written directly in the line.

faq.q: Do I need to remove secrets first?
faq.a: The tool is local, but logs often hold tokens. Use the log privacy workbench before sharing.
No. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
